findings.detail: The existing repository-held-out test split is absent from the review pack and remains sealed for confirmatory evaluation.
The largest source kind (git_history) contributes 60 of 61 cases. Report it as a raw concentration; do not hide it in an aggregate score.
The pack contains blank independent-review templates, not human judgments. It cannot be called gold or used to approve production weights.
Real-workload repositories overlap Git-history sources: pallets-markupsafe. These tasks are diagnostic, not independent external validation.
No real-workload task comes from a repository outside the Git-history source set, so cross-source generalization is still unmeasured.
